layout.sidebar: w-64 flex-shrink-0 flex flex-col justify-between border-r border-gray-200 bg-white z-20
layout.header: h-16 flex items-center justify-between px-6 border-b border-gray-200 bg-white sticky top-0 z-10
layout.kanban_board: flex-1 overflow-x-auto overflow-y-hidden p-6 flex gap-6
layout.kanban_column: w-80 flex-shrink-0 flex flex-col h-full max-h-full bg-gray-100/50 rounded-lg border border-gray-200

sidebar_zones.description: 2 distinct zones: ESPACE ACTIF and ESPACE HISTORIQUE. Use uppercase overlines (h3 typography) to separate them.

kanban_card.description: Dense, functional card. Contains Trainee Name, Financer Badge, Trainer Name, Entry Date.
kanban_card.classes: bg-white p-4 rounded-md shadow-sm border border-gray-200 hover:shadow-md transition-shadow cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing mb-3 flex flex-col gap-3 relative group

onboarding_form.description: 2-column dense grid for rapid data entry.
onboarding_form.input_classes: h-9 text-sm border-gray-300 rounded-md focus:ring-slate-900 focus:border-slate-900 shadow-sm

closed_dossiers_table.description: Ultra-fast search on top, compact list below. Table uses crisp borders and minimal padding for data density.
closed_dossiers_table.container_classes: bg-white rounded-md shadow-sm border border-gray-200 overflow-hidden
closed_dossiers_table.th_classes: px-4 py-3 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider

data_testid_rules.general: ALL interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute formatted as role-action-element.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use lucide-react for all icons (e.g., LayoutDashboard, UserPlus, Archive, FileText).
Ensure the Kanban board columns strictly follow the 5 phases: 'Devis en attente', 'Devis validé', 'En action de formation', 'Fin d\'action de formation', 'Facturé'.
Form fields for Onboarding: nom, prénom, date naissance, adresse, email, téléphone, formateur (Select/Input), type financeur (Select: OPCO/CPF/Privé).
For Closed Dossiers, add a 'Documents' column or expandable row with links/icons for: devis signé, attestation, facture, justificatif.
Auto-archive logic: Provide a 'Mark as Paid' (Réglée) action in the 'Facturé' column that visually removes the card from the Kanban board and adds it to the Closed Dossiers view.
Ensure all components use .js extensions instead of .tsx as per environment constraints.
Implement drag-and-drop using a lightweight library (like dnd-kit or react-beautiful-dnd) if possible, ensuring data-testid is attached to draggable items.
Do NOT use 'Inter' font. Import and use 'Manrope' for headings and 'IBM Plex Sans' for body.
